# Moomoo — How to import trades from Moomoo into TradeZella using the file upload method?

Source: https://help.tradezella.com/en/articles/13430930-moomoo-how-to-import-trades-from-moomoo-into-tradezella-using-the-file-upload-method

To seamlessly import your trades from Moomoo into TradeZella, follow the steps below.



To export your trade history from Moomoo, you’ll need to use the Moomoo Desktop App (file export is not always available on mobile).

- Launch the Moomoo desktop platform and log in.

Launch the Moomoo desktop platform and log in.

- From the left sidebar, click Accounts and select Securities.

From the left sidebar, click Accounts and select Securities.



✅ Make sure you’re inside the correct trading account before exporting.

- Under your account summary, select History tab tab from the tabs: "Positions | Orders | History | Today's Stats"

Under your account summary, select History tab tab from the tabs: "Positions | Orders | History | Today's Stats"

- Select your desired date range. Use the date selector above the orders table to choose the range you want to export.

Select your desired date range. Use the date selector above the orders table to choose the range you want to export.

📌 We recommend selecting the full available range to include all trades.

- Export the file. Above the orders table, locate the small Export icon (next to the symbol search bar).Click the Export iconChoose Export to CSVSave the CSV file to your computer

Export the file. Above the orders table, locate the small Export icon (next to the symbol search bar).

- Click the Export icon

Click the Export icon

- Choose Export to CSV

Choose Export to CSV

- Save the CSV file to your computer

Save the CSV file to your computer



Visit the TradeZella Add Trade page or click the “Add Trade” button from the sidebar.

- If you’re importing into a new account, click “Add New Account”.

If you’re importing into a new account, click “Add New Account”.

- Choose Moomoo as your broker.

Choose Moomoo as your broker.

- Click Continue.

Click Continue.

- Select File Upload and click Continue

Select File Upload and click Continue

- Upload your CSV file

Upload your CSV file



If you’re uploading to an existing account, click the “+ Add Trades” button on the account → Select File Upload → Proceed as above.







## Common Errors

✅ Export must be from the History tab

- Make sure you’re exporting from: Accounts → History → Filled

Make sure you’re exporting from: Accounts → History → Filled

- If you export from another tab (like Orders or a different report view), the file may not match TradeZella’s expected format.

If you export from another tab (like Orders or a different report view), the file may not match TradeZella’s expected format.

✅ Sample File



If your file fails to upload, make sure it matches the sample Moomoo export format attached.



Importing your trades from Moomoo into TradeZella is designed to be simple and efficient. Once uploaded, you’ll have clean performance stats, accurate journaling data, and insights to improve your trading strategy.
